=SELECT
   h.index_id AS index_id,
   h.time AS time, 
   h.*,
   f.cumulative_ad AS cumulative_ad,
   (h.time < '{{$input.first().json.start_date}}') AS window_padding  
FROM n8n_olap.fact_exchange_index_histories AS h
LEFT JOIN n8n_olap.fact_market_flow_indicators AS f 
   ON h.index_id = f.index_id AND h.time = f.time 
WHERE has([{{$input.first().json.index_id_str}}], h.index_id)
AND h.time BETWEEN '{{$input.first().json.data_start_date}}' AND '{{$input.first().json.end_date}}'
FORMAT JSON

=INSERT INTO n8n_olap.fact_market_flow_indicators
WITH previous_prices AS (
    SELECT 
        index_id,
        time,
        index_value,
        lagInFrame(index_value, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY index_id ORDER BY time) AS prev_index_value
    FROM n8n_olap.fact_exchange_index_histories
)
SELECT 
    curr.index_id,
    curr.time,
    curr.net_breadth,
    curr.cumulative_ad,
    curr.ad_slope,
    curr.ad_slope_5,
    curr.breadth_ratio,
    COALESCE(
        (
            ((hist_curr.index_value / hist_curr.prev_index_value) - 1) * 100
        ) - (
            ((vn_curr.index_value / vn_curr.prev_index_value) - 1) * 100
        ),
        0.0
    ) AS index_return_differential,
    now() AS updated_at
FROM n8n_olap.fact_market_flow_indicators AS curr
LEFT JOIN previous_prices AS hist_curr 
  ON curr.index_id = hist_curr.index_id AND curr.time = hist_curr.time
LEFT JOIN previous_prices AS vn_curr 
  ON vn_curr.index_id = '{{ $json.baseline }}' AND curr.time = vn_curr.time
WHERE curr.time >= '{{ $json.start_date }}' 
  AND curr.time <= '{{ $json.end_date }}';

=SELECT * FROM n8n_olap.v_market_regime_context
WHERE time >= '{{ $json.start_date }}' AND time <= '{{ $json.end_date }}'
FORMAT JSON
